info.description: Enterprise-grade E2E Postman Suite for the Consumable Inventory Service Domain (BIAN-aligned, ADR-001/005/013/019/030/031/032). Registers a stock item, receives, issues and adjusts it (with a mandatory reason), watches the reorder level flag and the low-stock list follow the balance, updates and discontinues it and reads its history with signed quantities and balances; negative cases cover validation, "an issue never takes the balance below zero", duplicate SKUs, a discontinued item accepting no change, tenant isolation and the absence of DELETE, with RFC 7807 error_code assertions. It registers its own SKUs under its own generated tenant id (stockOrganisationId) because it asserts exact quantities, so it needs no organisationId from the Party Reference Data Directory.
info.name: Consumable Inventory Service - Stock Movements Suite

exec: pm.test('Every act is on the history, newest first', () => { pm.expect(json.map(e => e.action)).to.eql(['UPDATED', 'ADJUSTED', 'ISSUED', 'RECEIVED', 'INITIATED']); });

pm.test('Signed quantities and balances', () => { pm.expect(json[1].quantity).to.eql(5); pm.expect(json[1].balanceAfter).to.eql(8); pm.expect(json[2].quantity).to.eql(-12); pm.expect(json[2].balanceAfter).to.eql(3); pm.expect(json[4].balanceAfter).to.eql(10); });
pm.test('The adjustment carries its reason', () => pm.expect(json[1].reason).to.eql('recount after audit'));
pm.test('Our item, balance kept', () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(json[0].onHand).to.eql(8); });
